FROM emp_master em ,( -- 근무일수 = 근태일자 - 입사일(DATE_HIRE_SUBSIDIARY) + 1 (입사일 = 1일차) 기준 (~29일 : Level 1, 30~59일 : Level 2, 60일~ : Level 3) -- OT 시간 = month_total_ot_result 와 동일 기준 (tb_att_result_n + 확정된 Special OT) SELECT ot.employee_no ,SUM(CASE WHEN ot.att_date - TRUNC(le.date_hire_subsidiary) + 1 <= 29 THEN ot.ot_hours ELSE 0 END) AS ot_level1 ,SUM(CASE WHEN ot.att_date - TRUNC(le.date_hire_subsidiary) + 1 BETWEEN 30 AND 59 THEN ot.ot_hours ELSE 0 END) AS ot_level2 ,SUM(CASE WHEN ot.att_date - TRUNC(le.date_hire_subsidiary) + 1 >= 60 THEN ot.ot_hours ELSE 0 END) AS ot_level3 FROM (SELECT t.employee_no ,TRUNC(t.time_and_attendance_date) AS att_date ,NVL(t.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) + NVL(t.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0) AS ot_hours FROM tb_att_result_n t WHERE t.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM') AND LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')) UNION ALL SELECT ts.employee_no ,TRUNC(ts.time_and_attendance_date) AS att_date ,NVL(ts.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0) AS ot_hours FROM tb_att_special_ot_result_n ts WHERE ts.confirm_flag = 'Y' AND ts.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM') AND LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')) ) ot ,emp_master le WHERE le.employee_number = ot.employee_no AND le.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND le.grade = 'L34' AND le.date_hire_subsidiary IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ot.employee_no ) lv WHERE em.subsidiary_code = 'LGDVN' AND lv.employee_no(+) = em.employee_number AND em.date_hire_subsidiary <= LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')) AND (em.date_retire >= to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM') OR em.date_retire IS NULL) AND NVL(em.fse_yn, 'N') <> 'Y' AND NVL(em.flsa_yn, 'N') <> 'Y'
AND em.attribute10 = #{shiftCode}
AND em.assignment_category = #{categoryTitle}
AND em.grade = 'L34'
AND NVL(em.grade, ' ') <> 'L34'
AND em.organization_id = #{orgId}
AND em.employee_number = UPPER(#{empNo})
AND UPPER(em.full_name_local) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{empName}) || '%'
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') >= #{monthTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') <= #{monthTotalOtTo}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result_yyyy') >= #{yearTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result_yyyy') <= #{yearTotalOtTo}

,( -- 근무일수 = 근태일자 - 입사일(DATE_HIRE_SUBSIDIARY) + 1 (입사일 = 1일차) 기준 (~29일 : Level 1, 30~59일 : Level 2, 60일~ : Level 3) -- OT 시간 = month_total_ot_result 와 동일 기준 (tb_att_result_n + 확정된 Special OT) SELECT ot.employee_no ,SUM(CASE WHEN ot.att_date - TRUNC(le.date_hire_subsidiary) + 1 <= 29 THEN ot.ot_hours ELSE 0 END) AS ot_level1 ,SUM(CASE WHEN ot.att_date - TRUNC(le.date_hire_subsidiary) + 1 BETWEEN 30 AND 59 THEN ot.ot_hours ELSE 0 END) AS ot_level2 ,SUM(CASE WHEN ot.att_date - TRUNC(le.date_hire_subsidiary) + 1 >= 60 THEN ot.ot_hours ELSE 0 END) AS ot_level3 FROM (SELECT t.employee_no ,TRUNC(t.time_and_attendance_date) AS att_date ,NVL(t.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) + NVL(t.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(t.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0) AS ot_hours FROM tb_att_result_n t WHERE t.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM') AND LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')) UNION ALL SELECT ts.employee_no ,TRUNC(ts.time_and_attendance_date) AS att_date ,NVL(ts.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) + NVL(ts.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0) AS ot_hours FROM tb_att_special_ot_result_n ts WHERE ts.confirm_flag = 'Y' AND ts.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM') AND LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')) ) ot ,emp_master le WHERE le.employee_number = ot.employee_no AND le.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND le.grade = 'L34' AND le.date_hire_subsidiary IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ot.employee_no ) lv
WHERE em.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}
AND lv.employee_no(+) = em.employee_number AND em.date_hire_subsidiary <= LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')) AND (em.date_retire >= to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM') OR date_retire IS NULL) AND NVL(em.fse_yn, 'N') <> 'Y' AND NVL(em.flsa_yn, 'N') <> 'Y'
AND em.attribute10 = #{shiftCode}
AND em.assignment_category = #{categoryTitle}
AND em.grade = 'L34'
AND NVL(em.grade, ' ') <> 'L34'
AND em.organization_id = #{orgId}
AND em.employee_number = UPPER(#{empNo})
AND UPPER(em.full_name_local) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{empName}) || '%'
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') >= #{monthTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') <= #{monthTotalOtTo}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result_yyyy') >= #{yearTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'YYYY'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result_yyyy') <= #{yearTotalOtTo}
) SELECT #{sessionId} , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} , SYSDATE , 2 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5601' ,to_char(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'MM/YYYY') AS attendance_ym_start ,to_char(to_date(#{attendanceYm}, 'YYYYMM'), 'MM/YYYY') AS attendance_ym_end ,employee_org ,employee_no ,employee_name ,employee_grade ,actual_shift_code ,employee_category ,TO_CHAR(date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS date_hire_subsidiary ,to_char(year_ot) ,to_char(month_total_ot)
,to_char(weekday_day) ,to_char(holiday_day) ,to_char(public_holiday_day) ,to_char(weekday_night) ,to_char(weekday_af_night) ,to_char(holiday_night) ,to_char(public_holiday_night)
,to_char(CASE WHEN weekday_day_over_m_raw > weekday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_day_over_y_raw END) AS weekday_day_over_y ,to_char(CASE WHEN holiday_day_over_m_raw > holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE holiday_day_over_y_raw END) AS holiday_day_over_y ,to_char(CASE WHEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw > public_holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE public_holiday_day_over_y_raw END) AS public_holiday_day_over_y ,to_char(CASE WHEN weekday_night_over_m_raw > weekday_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_night_over_y_raw END) AS weekday_night_over_y ,to_char(CASE WHEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw > weekday_af_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_af_night_over_y_raw END) AS weekday_af_night_over_y ,to_char(CASE WHEN holiday_night_over_m_raw > holiday_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE holiday_night_over_y_raw END) AS holiday_night_over_y ,to_char(CASE WHEN ph_night_over_m_raw > ph_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE ph_night_over_y_raw END) AS public_holiday_night_over_y
,to_char(CASE WHEN weekday_day_over_m_raw > weekday_day_over_y_raw THEN weekday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_day_over_m ,to_char(CASE WHEN holiday_day_over_m_raw > holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN holiday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END) AS holiday_day_over_m ,to_char(CASE WHEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw > public_holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN public_holiday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END) AS public_holiday_day_over_m ,to_char(CASE WHEN weekday_night_over_m_raw > weekday_night_over_y_raw THEN weekday_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_night_over_m ,to_char(CASE WHEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw > weekday_af_night_over_y_raw THEN weekday_af_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_af_night_over_m ,to_char(CASE WHEN holiday_night_over_m_raw > holiday_night_over_y_raw THEN holiday_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END) AS holiday_night_over_m ,to_char(CASE WHEN ph_night_over_m_raw > ph_night_over_y_raw THEN ph_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END) AS public_holiday_night_over_m
,to_char(ot_level1) ,to_char(ot_level2) ,to_char(ot_level3)
FROM raw_data)) AA ORDER BY ORDER_BY, AA.EMPLOYEE_NO asc
